heading.title: Licensing of Drivers of Motor Vehicles

article.title: Form and contents of licences to drive.
article.html:
10Form and contents of licences to drive.

Section 10 · Chapter II · page 17 of the Act

(1) Every learner’s licence and driving licence, except a driving licence issued under section 18, shall be in such form and shall contain such information as may be prescribed by the Central Government.

(2) A learner’s licence or, as the case may be, driving licence shall also be expressed as entitling the holder to drive a motor vehicle of one or more of the following classes, namely:—

(a) motor cycle without gear;

(b) motor cycle with gear;

(c) 4[adapted vehicle];

(d) light motor vehicle;

5[(e) transport vehicle;]

(i) road-roller;

(j) motor vehicle of a specified description.

4 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 6, for “invalid carriage” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).

5 Subs. by Act 54 of 1994, s. 8, for cls. (e) to (h) (w.e.f. 14-11-1994).
